title:
Listens for Grid Actions and using the `componentId` of the action it reads the `selectedGridItems` from it.
Then it triggers an `ALERTS_SELECTION_UPDATE` action with the `selectedGridItems` as payload.

Can be used together with {@link UiSdlEpicUpdateComponentFilterAfterDelay} epic to update the list of
selected alerts.
name: CloseAlertsPopulateSelectionModalEpic
